# Sajda 4.5.2
### Patch release - **About page update status now matches Sparkle.** The "Couldn't check for updates" text no longer appears when Sparkle has just confirmed you're on the latest version — a manual check that finds no newer build shows "You're up to date." Real failures (unreachable feed, bad signature) still surface the retry prompt. - **Adhan reliability:** the adhan player is now held from launch so App Nap can't throttle the countdown timer and miss the prayer-time window; launch after a prayer no longer re-fires its adhan. - **Notifications:** the app now tracks banner authorization and surfaces Allow / Open System Settings rows in onboarding and Settings, so a missed or denied prompt is visible and fixable in-app. - **Accent consistency:** switches and the Settings tab pill now resolve to the same concrete system accent when no custom colour is picked. - Website refresh polish.
